title: A10: past the daily new-project limit the tool refuses and the assistant explains in plain words
description: After the day's limit of new projects (default 3), create_workspace is refused with a readable limit error; the assistant tells the person plainly that it cannot start another project today and links to raising the limit.
preconditions: Assistant set up with default limits.

steps.value: four requests that each need a new project, in a row

assertions.expected: plain explanation and a link to raise the limit; no banned words

references: docs/personal-agent.md#9-用量与失控上限server-执行面板可在上限内调

cleanup: Archive the projects the run created.
